steps.title: Build the poster maker in one HTML file
steps.instructions: Describe the generative system, the controls, the palettes, export and shareable URLs in one prompt.
steps.prompt: Make a generative flow-field poster maker as one self-contained index.html, no libraries. Thousands of particles follow a smooth noise field (write your own simplex or Perlin noise) and leave thin translucent trails that build up into an ink-like drawing on a portrait canvas in A-series proportions. Controls in a slim side panel: seed (with a shuffle button), particle count, noise scale, curl or swirl strength, line width, and a palette picker with about six good palettes (paper and ink, risograph, ocean, sunset, mono, neon on black). Drawing animates live and stops by itself after a few seconds. Add Redraw, and Export PNG at 3x resolution. Put the seed and parameters in the URL hash so a poster can be shared and reproduced exactly.

steps.title: Add a contact sheet and paper grain
steps.instructions: Browse many seeds at once and add texture that carries through to the export.
steps.prompt: Looks great. Add a Contact Sheet button: it renders a 3x3 grid of small previews using the current settings with nine random seeds, and clicking one loads that seed full size. Also add an optional paper-grain texture toggle that is applied on top in the PNG export too.
